input._script:
using JSON3, Base64
module GOFF end
module GON end
Base.include_string(GOFF, String(base64decode("")))
Base.include_string(GON, String(base64decode("")))
using CUDA
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "cuda" => string(CUDA.runtime_version()), "driver" => string(CUDA.driver_version()), "rows" => Any[])
function mk(n)
    b = CuArray([1.0 + 0.5 * sin(1.7 * i + 0.3 * i * i) + 0.3 * cos(2.9 * i) for i in 1:n])
    z() = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); o() = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1)
    return (b = b, bb = z(), x = z(), xb = CuArray([cos(0.37 * i) for i in 1:n]), r = z(), rb = z(), p = z(), pb = z(), Ap = z(), Apb = z(), rs = o(), rsb = o(), s = o(), sb = o(), t = o(), tb = o())
end
function run_adj(M, n, maxit)
    a = mk(n); st = M.initstacks_br_cg1d2_b_cuda(maxit, n); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_b_cuda(a.b, a.bb, a.x, a.xb, a.r, a.rb, a.p, a.pb, a.Ap, a.Apb, a.rs, a.rsb, a.s, a.sb, a.t, a.tb, n, maxit, 1.0e-300, 0.0, st...)
    return ((time_ns() - t0) / 1e6, Array(a.bb), Array(a.xb))
end
function run_pri(M, n, maxit)
    a = mk(n); CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_cuda(a.b, a.x, a.r, a.p, a.Ap, a.rs, a.s, a.t, n, maxit, 1.0e-300)
    return ((time_ns() - t0) / 1e6, Array(a.x))
end
for (n, maxit) in ((16, 8), (256, 32), (4096, 50), (65536, 50), (1048576, 50))
    row = Dict{String,Any}("n" => n, "maxit" => maxit)
    try
        for w in 1:2; run_adj(GOFF, n, maxit); run_adj(GON, n, maxit); run_pri(GOFF, n, maxit); run_pri(GON, n, maxit); end
        ba = Dict("off" => Inf, "on" => Inf); bp = Dict("off" => Inf, "on" => Inf); gb = nothing; gon = nothing; xo = nothing; xn = nothing
        for rep in 1:6
            (t, g, _) = run_adj(GOFF, n, maxit); ba["off"] = min(ba["off"], t); gb = g
            (t, g, _) = run_adj(GON, n, maxit); ba["on"] = min(ba["on"], t); gon = g
            (t, x) = run_pri(GOFF, n, maxit); bp["off"] = min(bp["off"], t); xo = x
            (t, x) = run_pri(GON, n, maxit); bp["on"] = min(bp["on"], t); xn = x
        end
        rel(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b)) / max(maximum(abs.(a)), 1e-300)
        row["adjoint_off_us_per_it"] = ba["off"] * 1e3 / maxit; row["adjoint_on_us_per_it"] = ba["on"] * 1e3 / maxit
        row["primal_off_us_per_it"] = bp["off"] * 1e3 / maxit; row["primal_on_us_per_it"] = bp["on"] * 1e3 / maxit
        row["grad_rel_diff"] = rel(gb, gon); row["primal_rel_diff"] = rel(xo, xn); row["grad_maxabs"] = maximum(abs.(gb)); row["grad_finite"] = all(isfinite, gon)
    catch e
        row["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 400)
    end
    push!(res["rows"], row)
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
